topic.title: Lonar: the meteor lake that turned pink
topic.angle: A lake in a meteorite crater in Maharashtra suddenly turned pink in 2020, and the cause was tiny salt-loving microbes.
key_facts: Lonar Lake is in Buldhana district, Maharashtra
It sits in a crater created by a meteorite impact tens of thousands of years ago (age estimates vary)
It is one of the few known hypervelocity impact craters in basaltic rock; its water is saline and alkaline
In June 2020 the lake turned pink
Studies attributed the colour to salt-loving microbes (haloarchaea), helped by lower water levels and higher salinity

scenes.caption: Tiny microbes, big colour

instagram_caption:
A lake made by a meteor, that suddenly turned pink. 🌸☄️

Lonar Lake in Maharashtra sits inside a crater left by a meteorite tens of thousands of years ago. Its water is salty and alkaline. Then in June 2020, the whole lake turned pink almost overnight, and people were stunned. 😲

So what changed its colour? 👀
